name: congstar
verdict: Brand of Telekom Deutschland GmbH, wholly owned by Deutsche Telekom AG. Nothing found.
note: Mobile network brand on the front of FC St. Pauli’s shirt (main sponsor since 2014-15). Rating note: none. congstar is a brand of Telekom Deutschland GmbH, which Deutsche Telekom AG wholly owns (congstar-telekom-ownership); Deutsche Telekom AG’s anchor shareholder is the Federal Republic of Germany, directly and through KfW, with roughly 28-30%, the rest free float (federal-republic-of-germany-record). Germany has no sourced record of serious abuses (METHOD.md), so its stake isn’t a link to abuse.
